# ViGEmBus 1.22.0

The virtual gamepad bus driver that lets a host show the remote user's controller to games as an
Xbox 360 pad. Its installer is built into `connect.exe` (Windows only), so nobody has to fetch it
separately; Connect runs it once, silently, after Windows asks for permission.
